openings.claim: Retain a row-level ledger and twelve evidence-backed decisions. Replace batch totals with spreadsheet/script revision resolution; active replacements require explicit links.
openings.discriminator: Against converting then preferring the newer report: explicit links avoid double-counting; equal quantities under different identifiers cannot establish identity. Missing links/undefined statuses yield bounded disagreement; the rival may yield unsupported definite claims.
openings.probe: Freeze both variants on both supplied copies before opening the key. Compare resolved batches, unsupported definite claims and requests; audit every retained row. Defeat: unsupported ledger claims, exceeding sixty minutes, fewer than twelve decisions or exceeding three requests. Timeout alone proves no utility.
openings.uncertainty: Supplied evidence determines resolution; linkage workload remains unknown. Never silently drop duplicate/unmatched rows; use only supplied conversion; never infer quantities from neighboring batches.

openings.claim: A blocker-to-batch table alongside D1 may let three follow-up slots cover more unresolved decisions; consolidate only the same specifically missing field/record.
openings.discriminator: Against batch-by-batch requests: shared absent status definitions/amendment references should require fewer requests for identical documented blocker coverage. Independent blockers give no coverage advantage; coverage cannot establish response-driven quantity resolution.
openings.probe: Within sixty-minute reviews, freeze consolidated/separate request lists on both copies. During the supplied twenty-minute comparison, count requests, verify grouped dependencies against records, and compare resolved batches/unsupported claims with the key. Defeat: hidden distinct missing records, lost documented blockers, added unsupported claims or exceeded time capacity.
openings.uncertainty: Shared blockers may not exist; no follow-up responses are supplied. Every unresolved batch remains explicit without a request slot; benefit/workload are unmeasured.

lineage.reason: Preserves relation, rival, defeats, caveats and declared fit.
Preserves distinct request-selection hypothesis, conditional comparison, defeats and uncertainty.

decision: Both remain probes. Cite supporting records for each reconciled quantity/bounded disagreement across twelve batches; at most three requests each name a missing field/record. Unknown resources permit no constraint relaxation.
